'''Jorko''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Myykian]] [[youngling]] who lived on [[At Attin]] with their [[Nooma|mother]], [[Nol|father]], a brother [[Neel]], a [[twin]] brother [[Jobo]] and a sister [[Tuloo]] during the [[New Republic Era]].

==Biography==
[[File:JorkoJoboHolo-SC-RealAdventure.png|thumb|250px|left|Jorko and his twin Jobo]]
Jorko was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Myykian]] [[youngling]] who lived on [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. He lived with his family on At Attin which consisted of<ref name="Real Adventure" /> his<ref name="Cant Say" /> mother, [[Nooma]], his father, [[Nol]], an older brother [[Neel]], a twin brother [[Jobo]] and a baby sister [[Tuloo]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> 

Sometime before [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> Jorko stole his brother Neel's protractor. Neel chased him around the house until Jorko jumped on Neel's head causing Neel to fall onto the credenza and sprain his trunk.<ref name="Cant Say" /> During 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="SCDate" /> after missing his [[Career Assessment Test]] the [[human]] [[Wim]] came to [[Neel's home|Jorko's home]] looking for Neel while Jorko, Jobo and Tuloo were watching a [[hologram]] [[Unidentified hologram circus|circus performance]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

==Personality and traits==
Jorko had [[Color|blue]] skin, black eyes, and blue hair.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

==Equipment==
Jorko wore a red and yellow outfit.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jorko first appeared in the first episode of [[2024]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]".<ref name="Real Adventure" /> The English subtitles of the episode on [[Disney+]] spelled the character's name as "Jorko."<ref name="Real Adventure Sub">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> However, his [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry initially stated that his name was spelled "Jorka,"<ref name="Jorka Error">{{Databank|jorka-jobo-and-tuloo|Jorka, Jobo, and Tuloo|oldversion=20241205160306}}</ref> though it was later changed to "Jorko,"<ref name="Databank" /> making it consistent with the subtitles.<ref name="Real Adventure Sub" />
